subject: Copywriting
title: Privacy-First Email Marketing
description: Learn Privacy-First Email Marketing in one minute.

hook.text: Apple's Mail Privacy Protection hid open rates from 50% of email users overnight. Marketers lost their favorite metric.

buildup.text: iOS 15 pre-loaded email tracking pixels, making every email appear 'opened.' Open rates became fictional overnight.

discovery.text: Marketers shifted to click rates, reply rates, and revenue per email.

twist.text: Privacy regulations will only tighten. Third-party cookies are dying.

climax.text: The brands that collect email ethically and deliver genuine value will thrive in a privacy-first world.

punchline.text: Open rates died. Click rates and revenue live. Privacy changed email.

quiz.question: What did Apple's Mail Privacy Protection do?
